page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening) holding a title page, centred; no running text, no notes. Bottom of the scan carries a digitiser's banner, which is left out.
page.notes: The title page is set in the printer's italic and capitals; the date is printed in the old reversed-C form and is rendered as the ordinary numeral MDCLXI. The hyphenated line "doctorum" is printed as "docto-" / "rum" and is joined here. The left page of the opening is a cover edge with no legible print and is left out.
